lc_person: Paul Addison (1943–2020), University of Edinburgh historian of twentieth-century British politics and the Second World War; author of Now the war is over.
item_person: Paul Addison (1943–2020), historian affiliated with the University of Edinburgh, sharing LC authority n86110514 and VIAF 49270310.

evidence.says: The authorized heading is Addison, Paul, 1943-2020. The 1985 source for Now the war is over identifies Paul Addison as Reader in History at the University of Edinburgh. LC links Q7149011 and VIAF 49270310. Its structured birthDate is 1946-05-03, but its 1987 heading source gives 1943 and its 2021 biographical source gives 1943–2020.

Q7149011 is labeled Paul Addison and described as a historian (1943–2020). It gives birth year 1943, death year 2020, LC identifier n86110514, VIAF 49270310, and employer University of Edinburgh (Q160302).
The graph’s author identifier OL474961A names Paul Addison and gives birth year 1943.
Lists Now the war is over, The road to 1945, and Churchill on the home front, matching the LC author and the Edinburgh historian’s works.
The second graph author identifier also lists Now the war is over, Road To 1945, and Churchill on the home front, although it also contains programming and business-journalism titles.

The University of Edinburgh’s obituary identifies Addison as a historian of British politics during the Second World War and of Churchill; he joined Edinburgh in 1967 and wrote The Road to 1945 and Now the War is Over.

Ian S. Wood’s obituary, published 12 February 2020, explicitly gives birth year 1943 and death year 2020, and identifies the Edinburgh historian who wrote The Road to 1945 and Churchill on the Home Front.

notes: The automatic birth disagreement reflects an apparent error in LC’s structured birthDate, not two people: LC’s heading and source notes agree with Wikidata and the obituary on 1943. The second Open Library author record appears mixed, but the first record and matching historical works support the LC-to-graph identification.
